description.value: Bagheera is a hidden speakeasy cocktail bar in Vancouver's Chinatown, concealed behind the fictional storefront of the Happy Valley Turf Club — a betting parlour facade that masks the entrance. Inside, the theme shifts to Victorian India and Jungle Book imagery, with expertly crafted cocktails and small Indian-inspired dishes. The elaborate concept extends to the bar's own website, which is disguised as a horse-racing racecard.

raw_osm.description: Bagheera is a hidden speakeasy cocktail bar in Vancouver's Chinatown, accessed through the fictional Happy Valley Turf Club. With Jungle Book-themed decor, it offers expertly crafted cocktails and small Indian dishes in a cozy atmosphere.
raw_osm.description:en: Bagheera is a hidden speakeasy cocktail bar in Vancouver's Chinatown, accessed through the fictional Happy Valley Turf Club. With Jungle Book-themed decor, it offers expertly crafted cocktails and small Indian dishes in a cozy atmosphere.
raw_osm.description:fr: Bagheera est un bar secret derrière le fictif Happy Valley Turf Club à Vancouver, avec une décoration inspirée du Livre de la jungle. Les clients savourent des cocktails raffinés et des plats indiens dans une atmosphère immersive, parfaite pour soirée.
raw_osm.description:ja: バギーラは、バンクーバーのチャイナタウンにある架空のハッピーバレー競馬クラブの外観の裏に位置する隠れたスピークイージーのカクテルバーです。豪華なジャングルブックをテーマにした装飾と独特の入場プロセスを特徴としており、ゲストは居心地の良い没入型の雰囲気の中で、巧みに作られたカクテルや小さな風味豊かなインド料理を楽しむことができ、特別な夜のお出かけに最適なスポットです。
raw_osm.description:ko: 바기라는 밴쿠버 차이나타운의 허구의 해피 밸리 경마 클럽 외관 뒤에 위치한 숨겨진 스피크이지 칵테일 바입니다. 화려한 정글 북 테마 장식과 독특한 입장 프로세스를 특징으로 하며, 손님들은 아늑하고 몰입감 있는 분위기 속에서 정교하게 제작된 칵테일과 작은 인도 요리를 즐길 수 있어 특별한 밤 외출에 완벽한 장소입니다.
raw_osm.description:zh: Bagheera 是一家隐藏的秘密酒吧，位于温哥华唐人街虚构的快乐谷赛马俱乐部的外表后面，拥有奢华的《丛林之书》主题装饰和独特的入场流程。客人可以在舒适、沉浸的氛围中享用精心调制的鸡尾酒和小份美味的印度菜肴，是一个完美的特别夜晚去处。
raw_osm.name: Bagheera
raw_osm.note:alt_name: Happy Valley Turf Club is the fictional front company for the speakeasy bar, and is what is visible on the street.
